dialogues.speaker: Keratry
dialogues.text: C'mon, brother, be my magic assistant!

dialogues.speaker: Remaudiere
dialogues.text: Hah, do you think it'll be that easy? I am so very mighty in magic — how could I be your assistant?

dialogues.speaker: Keratry
dialogues.text: Oh, I know, I know! I'll pay you a general salary! How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Remaudiere
dialogues.text: Don't you mean a "generous" salary? Also, who taught you those ideas about utility?

dialogues.speaker: Keratry
dialogues.text: Just tell me if you agree or not, c'mon...

dialogues.speaker: Remaudiere
dialogues.text: Well... That's a difficult question. See, I'm currently twice your age.

dialogues.speaker: Remaudiere
dialogues.text: By the time you become an adult, I'll already be in my middle age and have started to lose hair — I shan't be able to be your partner then.

dialogues.speaker: Keratry
dialogues.text: Can't I use magic to make you not grow up?

dialogues.speaker: Remaudiere
dialogues.text: Dear sister, we're speaking of magic tricks, not magic...
